preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 200000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices with labels between 1 and n.
The given edges form a connected undirected graph with n vertices and n-1 edges (a tree).

postconditions.description: The output is the integer representing the maximum possible cost of the tree.

postconditions.expression: max_cost == max(sum(dist(i, v) * a[i-1] for i in range(1, n+1)) for v in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The maximum cost is the maximum value of the sum of distances from a chosen vertex v to all other vertices i, weighted by a_i, over all possible choices of v.
